title: KubeNDT: A Network Digital Twin platform in Kubernetes
description: KubeNDT is a platform for deploying and operating virtual network topologies on Kubernetes. Topologies are defined declaratively and materialized as Kubernetes-native resources, with a driver and capability system that applies the same network configuration actions regardless of the container image each node runs.

creators.name: García de la Calera Molina, Emilio
